raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Hey Jolene, nice to meet you! How's your week going? Anything fun happened?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Hi Deb! Good to meet you! Yeah, my week's been busy. I finished an electrical engineering project last week - took a lot of work, but it's done now. Anything fun happening for you?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Congrats! Last week I visited a place that holds a lot of memories for me. It was my mother`s old house.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Why does it hold such special memories for you?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a woman in a wheelchair hugging a woman in a wheelchair] It was full of memories, she passed away a few years ago. This is our last photo together.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a room with a bench and a window] Sorry about your loss, Deb. My mother also passed away last year. This is my room in her house, I also have many memories there. Is there anything special about it you remember?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: My mom's house had a special bench near the window. She loved to sit there every morning and take in the view. I come to sit here sometimes, it helps me stay connected to her.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a heart shaped pendant with a bird on it] Staying connected is super important. Do you have something to remember her by? This pendant reminds me of my mother, she gave it to me in 2010  in Paris.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Yes, I also have a pendant that reminds me of my mother. And what is special for you about your jewelry?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: It has a special symbol on it that represents freedom for me. It's a nice reminder to go for my goals and not get held back.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: It should really give you strength and energy!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Do you have goals?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: One of my goals is to keep teaching yoga and supporting my community. I'm passionate about helping people find peace and joy through it.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: What inspired you to go down this route?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Yoga helped me find peace during a rough time, and now I'm passionate about sharing that with others.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: It is truly inspiring!

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Gotta run, bye!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Looking forward to the next chat!

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a woman hugging a woman who is sitting on a couch] Hey Jolene, sorry to tell you this but my dad passed away two days ago. It's been really tough on us all - his sudden death left us all kinda shell-shocked. I'm trying to channel my grief by spending more time with family and cherishing the memories. These moments remind me to live life fully.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Sorry to hear about your dad, Deborah. Losing a parent is tough - how's it going for you and your family?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a bride and groom posing for a picture] Even though it's hard, it's comforting to look back on the great memories. We looked at the family album. Photos give me peace during difficult times. This is my parents' wedding in 1993.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: They were a beautiful couple!

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: My husband and I are trying to be as good a family as my parents were!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: What do you value in your relationship?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a note written to someone on a piece of paper] It is love, and openness that have kept us close all these years. Being there for each other has made us both happy. Look what letter I received yesterday!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: What touching words! Who is this letter from?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: The group members sent this to me! They thanked me for the positive influence I had on them. Those moments remind me why I'm so passionate about yoga.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Where do you most often do yoga?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a living room with a television and a window] This is one of the places where I do it.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Where is it?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: That's my old home. I go there now and then for my mom, who passed away. Sitting in that spot by the window gives me peace.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Must be great to have that place where you feel connected to her.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a window seat in a room with a window] Yeah, it's special. I can feel her presence when I sit there and it comforts me.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Wow, it sounds like that spot holds a lot of sentimental value. Does it bring back any special memories?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a view of the sky from an airplane window] Yeah, Jolene. She'd sit there every night with a book and a smile, reading was one of her hobbies. It was one of her favorite places in the house.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: What other hobbies did your mother have?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Travel was also her great passion!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a bed with a snake head sticking out of it] I want to show you one of my snakes! They always calm me down and make me happy. This is Susie.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Having a pet totally brightens up your life. It's great that it brings you comfort. Do you have any fun moments with your pet that you'd like to share?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a snake sticking its head out of a blanket]  I was playing video games and my pet just slinked out of her cage and coiled up next to me - it was too funny! My second snake Seraphim did it. Look at her sly eyes!

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Awww, that's so nice!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: I bought it a year ago in Paris.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Cool, Jolene! Pets bring so much happiness!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a person laying in bed with a dog watching tv] They are very unusual pets! Here's me and my partner gaming last week - it's so fun. We played the game "Detroit" on the console. We are both crazy about this activity!

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Did your boyfriend teach you to play?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Even as a child I learned to play on my own.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Do you only play old games or try new ones?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: We are planning to play "Walking Dead" next Saturday.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Take care and keep spreading those good vibes!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Thanks, Deb! You too, take care. See ya!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a table with a robot on it and a laptop] Hi Deb! How're you? I've been busy. My engineering professor gave us a huge robotics project. It's tough but fun, it's making me get creative and problem-solve.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Hey Jolene! It's great to hear from you. It sounds challenging but interesting! It must be really putting your creative and problem-solving skills to the test. How did you feel when you first received the project? Are you enjoying working on it?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: When I got it, I felt a mix of emotions - excited and nervous. But now, I'm really enjoying it! It's like trying to solve a puzzle, figuring out the best design and programming. Seeing the robot come together is awesome too!

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a yellow sign with a picture of a family] That's awesome, Jolene! You're enjoying the process. It must be really satisfying to see it come together. Keep up the good work! Oh, by the way, I met my new neighbor Anna yesterday!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: How did you two meet?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: It happened at yoga in the park.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Wow, that's awesome! It's great connecting with people who have similar interests. Did you two talk about it?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Yeah, we talked about how it has improved our lives and the sense of community it gives.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a purse with a plant on a table] Sounds great!

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Have you ever thought about resuming yoga?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Well... we planned to play the console with my partner.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: It's also good that you have something to do together.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Thanks for the kind words!

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Gotta run bye!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: See you soon!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Hey Deborah! Good to hear from you. How've you been? I've been on an emotional rollercoaster lately, but I'm coping.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you. All good here - how about you? Anything new happening lately?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: I had a major milestone last week and it went really well - I'm so relieved and proud. It was a huge accomplishment for me as an engineer.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: That's awesome. You must have worked really hard for that. I'm so proud of you. Care to share more about it?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Thanks so much! I had to plan and research a lot to design and build a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need. It was tough, but I loved the experience.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Your engineering skills really made a difference for people in a rural area. That's amazing! How did it feel when you saw it working?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: It was such a surreal moment. Seeing it working and providing clean water to the community was incredibly satisfying. It reminded me of how engineering can make a difference in people's lives. It made me feel like I had a purpose and had done something good.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: So, what are your career aspirations now?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: I want to keep working in engineering and continue to make a positive impact on communities in need by creating sustainable solutions. My goal is to contribute towards making the world a better place with my work.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: I'm sure great things will keep coming your way. Keep up the good work and follow your passions!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Your support means a lot. I'm determined to keep going and make a difference. Your encouragement really motivates me to pursue my passions.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of two women in a dance studio doing a dance pose] When things get tough, just take a deep breath and remember why you're doing this. This is where I spend a lot of my time, teaching yoga. It's a great way to find balance and reconnect with ourselves. I bonded with Anna during yesterday's l yoga class.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Wow, that's awesome! What new poses did you try?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on a chair] We were trying out different dance poses, like Warrior II, which builds strength and boosts focus.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Is it difficult to do?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Yes, but this brought us closer to Anna! We supported each other, that means a lot.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Can you explain how to do it?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Sure! To do this modified pose, sit on the edge of a chair with your feet planted. Twist your torso to one side and use your hand on your knee for support. You'll feel a stretch in your back and shoulders as you hold it for a few breaths, then switch sides. It's great for relaxing tense muscles.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a book shelf with a lot of books on it] Sounds really hard! Here's my bookshelf!

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: That's quite a collection! Have you had a favorite book lately? I'd love to hear your thoughts.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Thanks Deborah! I'm really into this book called "Sapiens" - it's a fascinating look at human history and how technology has affected us. It's giving me a lot to think about!

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Great, this is interesting! Have you come across any recent ones that really struck you?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Two weeks ago I read "Avalanche" by Neal Stephenson in one sitting!

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: That sounds cool, Jolene. Stories can be so powerful - they can teach us, motivate us, and bring us together.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: I also read a recent story about someone who became successful despite facing numerous challenges. It really showed me that anything is possible if you believe and work hard.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a bouquet of flowers in a vase on a table] That's a really powerful message. It reminds me of someone special and their grace and strength when they faced hardships. Check out this creation!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Wow, Deb! That's beautiful! Can you tell me the backstory of that bouquet?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: My friend gave me this bouquet when I was struggling, and it gives me hope and courage. I'm filled with warmth and appreciation when I look at it.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: That's really sweet. Such a small thing can make a real difference.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: It's amazing how something as simple as flowers can make a real difference. Nature sure is beautiful.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Where are some of your favorite nature spots?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Oh, there's so many great places! My favorite is a park with a forest trail - it's so calming getting lost in nature. Then there's this beach nearby that I love - the sound of the waves and the sand under my feet make me feel all peaceful and happy. Do you have any favorite spots, Jolene?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard] Here's a picture I took on vacation last summer in Bogota. It was so beautiful and calming watching the sunset over the water. It definitely made me appreciate nature's calming power.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a small island with a lone boat in the water] That sounds great, Jolene. Nature's calming for sure. Guess it helps us forget the daily craziness and find inner peace. No wonder you're a fan! I like to come to this spot by the water near my mom's old house. It's where I reflect on her life and find some peace. Being surrounded by nature helps a lot.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: That's so touching! Do you have any little traditions that you do when you come to reflect on your mom?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a woman wearing a white shirt and a gold chain necklace] Do you remember this amulet from her? Whenever I come here, I bring it with me. It's how I feel her love and stay close to her. Holding it brings me comfort.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: It's amazing how something so small can have such a big impact, huh?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Yeah, even small things like this can make a big difference. It's a reminder of all the love and strength we have inside, connecting us to people we've lost and comforting us.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: It can keep them close in our hearts every day.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Anna also has a pendant that she wears in memory of her mother! This also brought us closer.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: It's nice to have those reminders as a source of strength when we need it.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Life's tough but hang in there. Look to your sources of strength and you'll do great. Stay in touch, take care of yourself, and know I'm always here to cheer you on!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Thanks, Deb! Your encouragement means a lot to me. I'll definitely stay in touch. Bye, take care and keep shining!

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Stay safe!  Bye!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Hey Deborah! Been a few days since we last talked so I wanted to fill you in on something cool. Last Wednesday I did a mini retreat to assess where I'm at in life. It was a dope experience that totally gave me a new outlook.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Hey Jolene! Sounds great. Taking time to reflect can be really awesome. Did you gain any new insights from it?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Yep! I achieved so much more than I imagined. It was a real confidence boost.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: You deserve credit for stepping outside your comfort zone and believing in yourself. What cool stuff did you accomplish at the retreat?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: I really accomplished something with my engineering project - I came up with some neat solutions and I'm really excited about it.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Let's go into more detail.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Green tech could really make a difference in disadvantaged areas. I'd like to look into it and see how I can contribute. Hey, speaking of helping out, I had an idea: a volunteer program where engineers teach STEM to underprivileged kids. What do you think of that?

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: That sounds great, Jolene! It's a great way to help and inspire others. They would benefit a lot from your knowledge. Have you thought of a plan yet?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Haven't finished planning yet but I'm thinking of teaming up with local schools/centers to do workshops. We could even invite engineers as guest speakers to show kids their career options.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Having guest speakers, like them, would definitely give the kids a real-world view. Have you reached out to any schools or centers yet?

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: No, not yet. I want to solidify the plan first. Can't wait to start reaching out, though!

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: That makes sense. I'm excited to hear how you reach out and help those kids. Let me know how it goes!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a notebook with a pen and a notebook with a page of notes] I'll keep you posted! Appreciate the support! Here are my sketches in the planner.

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: Sounds like you're doing great. Let me know if you need more tips or information.

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Thanks, Deb! If I need anything else, I'll let you know. You're awesome!

raw_turns.speaker: Deborah
raw_turns.text: You're awesome too! Take care!

raw_turns.speaker: Jolene
raw_turns.text: Stay safe!
